from model import Order, Product, Status
from money import plain
from orders import grand_total, status_label

STATUS_CODES = {
    Status.DRAFT: "D",
    Status.PAID: "P",
    Status.ON_HOLD: "H",
    Status.PACKED: "K",
    Status.SHIPPED: "S",
    Status.DELIVERED: "V",
    Status.CANCELLED: "X",
}


def status_code(s: Status) -> str:
    """A one-letter code for the warehouse system."""
    return STATUS_CODES[s]


def order_row(o: Order) -> str:
    """A row of the orders file."""
    return f"{o.id},{status_code(o.status)},{status_label(o.status)},{plain(grand_total(o))}"


def product_row(p: Product) -> str:
    """A row of the products file."""
    return f"{p.sku},{p.name},{plain(p.price)},{p.weight:.2f}"


def orders_file(os: list[Order]) -> str:
    """The orders file."""
    return "\n".join(["id,code,status,total", *(order_row(o) for o in os)])

from crm import display_name
from model import Customer, Line, Order
from money import fmt
from orders import grand_total, line_total, subtotal


def header(o: Order, c: Customer) -> str:
    """The first line of an invoice."""
    return f"Invoice {o.id} for {display_name(c)}, {c.city}"


def line_text(l: Line) -> str:
    """One line of goods."""
    return f"  {l.qty} x {l.sku} @ {fmt(l.unit_price)} = {fmt(line_total(l))}"


def due_note(total: int) -> str:
    """How long the customer has to pay."""
    if total > 10000:
        return "payable in 30 days"
    return "payable in 14 days"


def invoice_text(o: Order, c: Customer) -> str:
    """A whole invoice."""
    rows = [line_text(l) for l in o.lines]
    tail = [
        f"goods: {fmt(subtotal(o))}",
        f"shipping: {fmt(o.shipping)}",
        f"total: {fmt(grand_total(o))}",
        due_note(grand_total(o)),
    ]
    return "\n".join([header(o, c), *rows, *tail])

files.model.py:
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum


class Status(Enum):
    """Where an order is in its life."""
    DRAFT = "draft"
    PAID = "paid"
    ON_HOLD = "on_hold"
    PACKED = "packed"
    SHIPPED = "shipped"
    DELIVERED = "delivered"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"


class Tier(Enum):
    BASIC = "basic"
    SILVER = "silver"
    GOLD = "gold"


class Category(Enum):
    BOOK = "book"
    TOY = "toy"
    FOOD = "food"
    TOOL = "tool"
    GARDEN = "garden"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Product:
    sku: str
    name: str
    price: int
    weight: float
    category: Category
    stock: int
    supplier: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Customer:
    id: int
    first_name: str
    last_name: str
    email: str
    tier: Tier
    city: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Line:
    sku: str
    qty: int
    unit_price: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Order:
    id: int
    customer: int
    lines: list[Line]
    status: Status
    shipping: int
    day: int
